decision_rule: Suitability is determined before and independently of performance. External physical mechanism evidence is not streetlight field accuracy or fault probability.

grade_definitions.SG-A: All declared-mechanism requirements pass, including labels/provenance, physical and temporal provenance, applicable channel identity, sealable independent split, and explicit usable licence.
grade_definitions.SG-B: Strong labelled and physical provenance, with a declared limitation that narrows but does not invalidate the registered mechanism.
grade_definitions.SG-C: Potentially useful evidence but a partial or unknown gate blocks confirmatory execution.
grade_definitions.SG-X: Fundamental benchmark requirement fails; exclude from execution.

records.dataset_type: Pre-processed real industrial electrical-distribution power-quality time series derived from proprietary Neuville Grid Data measurements.
records.license_evidence: No explicit data-use licence is shown on the official record.
records.label_provenance: UNKNOWN: a disturbance classification label is stated, but classes, source events, and generation procedure are not documented publicly.
records.physical_provenance: Upstream/downstream min/mean/max voltage statistics in kV/V and voltage THD percent are stated; phase-resolved current/channel identity is not stated.
records.timestamp_or_order: PARTIAL: minute-level time-series data are stated; exported timestamp schema and continuity are not described in the metadata.
records.access_status: Official record exposes separate train/test downloads; no raw manifest is recorded here.
records.split_status: PARTIAL: named train/test files exist; unit, chronology, and construction are undocumented.
records.allowed_scope_if_released: Voltage/THD disturbance only; no phase-current, streetlight, or fault-probability claim.
risks: Proprietary-origin transformations are not fully auditable.
Open download does not establish a reuse licence.

records.dataset_type: Controlled laboratory electromagnetic-disturbance experiment on a real three-phase VFD.
records.license_evidence: Official KU Leuven RDR record states CC BY 4.0.
records.label_provenance: PASS: binary point-level label indicates deliberate injected electromagnetic disturbance presence/absence.
records.physical_provenance: Official README identifies Time(s), Phase_A(A), Phase_B(A), and Label. The two channels are identified Amperes, but they are not complete three-phase phasors.
records.timestamp_or_order: PASS: README identifies Time(s) for each 2.5 MHz measurement run.
records.access_status: Official record/API and README identify 100 runs, without recording a raw manifest here.
records.split_status: No author split. A deterministic run-disjoint partition can be sealed before label use.
records.allowed_scope_if_released: Injected EMD/current-change discrimination and persistence under run-disjoint evaluation only.
risks: Laboratory intervention is not a field-fault outcome.
Two channels do not establish complete three-phase phasor or negative-sequence quantities.
Large raw data must stay outside Git.

records.dataset_type: Real single-household aggregate and appliance electrical-monitoring dataset in Portugal.
records.license_evidence: Official IEEE PES SustDataED2 registry explicitly states CC BY 4.0.
records.label_provenance: PASS: human review corrected false positives/false negatives in semi-automatic appliance-event labels; stated 10% criterion and 12,252 labels. Transition labels are not faults.
records.physical_provenance: Actual 96-day household monitoring; 12.8 kHz calibrated voltage/current waveforms and 1 Hz active/reactive power, voltage RMS, current RMS; one aggregate single-phase service, no per-phase identity.
records.timestamp_or_order: PASS: UTC transition timestamps and first-sample timestamps are documented.
records.sampling: Raw voltage/current 12.8 kHz; processed 50 Hz and 1 Hz; appliance readings about 0.5 Hz.
records.access_status: OSF DOI and IEEE PES registry are official access evidence; no raw manifest is recorded here.
records.split_status: No author split; a chronological time-forward within-house seal is possible but is not an independent-household holdout.
records.allowed_scope_if_released: Real aggregate-load transition/change positive control with a pre-registered time-forward within-house split only; transitions are not faults.
risks: Appliance transition ground truth is not an electrical fault label.
Single-house results cannot establish entity-disjoint transport.
No phase-current mechanism claim is available.

records.dataset_type: Public 3PhaseInsight data-specification report; not a raw labelled electrical dataset.
records.license_evidence: Zenodo record shows a public report and no stated rights field for raw Radius data.
records.label_provenance: FAIL: no public outcome/event labels are released.
records.physical_provenance: Report documents semantic fields for per-phase voltage, active/reactive power, and harmonic distortion, but publishes no measurement rows, calibration, or raw file manifest.
records.timestamp_or_order: FAIL: no public time-series artefact is released.
records.sampling: UNKNOWN for an executable public dataset.
records.access_status: Public Zenodo record is report-only; no raw measurement benchmark access is established.
records.split_status: FAIL: no public labelled benchmark partition exists.
records.allowed_scope_if_released: None. It may be cited only as contextual documentation of a three-phase data model.
risks: Report access is not raw data access.
Underlying DSO data may be sensitive.
No benchmark label or partition can be inferred.

cross_dataset_rules: Performance must not influence suitability or dataset routing.
London Met may transfer to CoDEx only after CoDEx independently passes its provenance gate; no London Met result can justify that transfer.
External physical mechanism evidence is not streetlight field accuracy, field recall/FPR, municipal production readiness, or actual fault probability.
Raw external files, transformed derivatives, credentials, and sensitive DSO material remain out of Git.
